_doc: Studio film (docs/shotlist-studio.md). Beats are 0-based and may be fractional (16ths); each sound lands on the measured peak nearest that grid point.

music._doc: Beat spans [from, to). pulse = kick + light hats, groove = full kit; drop beats lose the drums; hold silences drums from that beat; risers [from, to, gain]; boom/crash beats. loop false = the film ends, last half second fades.
